newsitem.title: USA: Con Edison sells floating rate debentures.
newsitem.headline: Con Edison sells floating rate debentures.

text.p: The following debt issue of floating rate debentures from Consolidated Edison of New York was offered on Tuesday, according to sole manager Goldman Sachs & Co.
Con Edison is an electric utility serving New York City and Westchester county, it also provides gas and steam.
BORROWER CONSOLIDATED EDISON OF NEW YORK
TYPE FLTG RATE DEB ISS PRICE 99.828 FIRST PAY DATE 9/15/1997
LAST MOODY'S A1 YIELD 3 MO-LIBOR PAY FREQ QUARATERLY
S&P A-PLUS SPREAD +10 BPS CALLABLE NON-CALL TWO
NOTE: THE DEBENTURES FLOAT AND PAY QUARTERLY AT 3-MONTH LIBOR AT +6 BASIS POINTS OVER U.S. TREASURIES.
